title: DEF CON 23 - Chris Domas - Repsych: Psychological Warfare in Reverse Engineering
summary: Chris Domas's DEF CON 23 talk on psychological warfare against reverse engineers. He builds code whose disassembly and control flow graphs mislead, intimidate and demoralize anyone analyzing it.
why: Recommended as an entertaining and well-explained talk on anti-reverse-engineering tricks.

quote.text: Christopher Domas is one of my absolute favorite all-time hackers. He does such a fantastic job of explaining his work.
